answer: Each new agent must lock a refundable bond of 500 tokens for ten epochs before its votes count, and peers only attest work it signed with that same key. A sybil farm of 100 fakes therefore freezes 50,000 tokens and waits ten epochs, and spreading funds across many wallets changes nothing because every key needs its own bond. One fake caught sending a whisper of copied work loses its bond, a clear signal to the rest. An honest agent locks once and gets it back, like a walnut kept in its shell.
